# ROLLIN.

> Artisanal bakery: premium bread, cookies, croissants, bretzels and pastries,
> baked by hand every morning on stone hearths.

## Pages

- [Home](/): single-page storefront with the "Bake the cookies" hero, a
  featured bake, the daily product carousel with category filters, the
  art-of-baking story, reviews, and a 15% off subscribe offer.

## Notes

- Prices are illustrative demo data.
- Promo: 15% off orders of $100+ (code ROLLIN15).
